Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- The entry describes both fields, their defaults, their units, and their refused values.
- I checked the entry against the current implementation and the existing tests in `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `7f2d9bfc4efe40dbf12e06c93f2675896814925b`:

- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -v -s .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests`: 4 tests passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 2 changed files; no Rust test steps selected.
- The xtask build passed with the inherited compile cache disabled. The first attempt stopped after the cache gave no output.
- Application builds, Rust suites, and clippy did not run. This PR changes only documentation and its Python contract test.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision checks. Safety mutations do not apply. No goldens or UI files change. No live MCP session ran.

The review uses the current upstream/main AGENTS.md.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
